name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Central Sector scheme providing income support of Rs. 6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 directly to bank accounts of all landholding farmer families across India.
benefits: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per year per eligible farmer family
Transferred in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months
100% centrally funded Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts
eligibility: All landholding farmer families possessing cultivable agricultural land registered in official state land records
Valid Aadhaar card linked with bank account and active e-KYC status on PM-KISAN portal
Land record details (Khata/Khasra/Khatauni) registered and verified in the State Land Record Management System
exclusions: Institutional landholders (trusts, companies, societies)
Farmer families where any member is a current or former holder of constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, Chairpersons of District Panchayats
All serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Govt Ministries/Departments and public sector undertakings (excluding multi-tasking / Class IV / Group D employees)
All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
All superannuated/retired pensioners with monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding Group D)
Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out practice
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card
Land ownership documents / Khatauni copy
Aadhaar-seeded bank account passbook
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar for OTP/e-KYC
applicationProcess: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and click on 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar number and mobile number, select State, and verify via OTP
Fill in personal, landholding (Khata/Khasra/area), and bank details
Upload land ownership certificate (RoR/Khatauni) and submit for State Nodal Officer verification
Alternatively, visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Patwari/Revenue officer
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
unresolvedQuestions: Discrepancies in mutation dates between states for determining cutoff eligibility
Status of joint landholders where individual holding acreage is under dispute

unsupportedCriteria: Must hold cultivable land ownership documented in state digital land records
Strict exclusion of income tax payers in the last assessment year
Strict exclusion of institutional landholders and constitutional post holders
Strict exclusion of government employees and pensioners earning >= Rs 10,000/month
Mandatory biometric/OTP e-KYC completion on official PM-KISAN portal

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Flagship Central scheme providing collateral-free institutional loans up to Rs. 20 Lakh to non-corporate, non-farm micro and small enterprises for income-generating activities in manufacturing, trading, services, and agriculture-allied activities.
benefits: Collateral-free institutional credit with no third-party guarantee required
Four loan tiers: Shishu (up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 Lakh), Tarun (Rs. 5 Lakh to Rs. 10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 20 Lakh for past Tarun borrowers)
Subsidized processing fees and affordable interest rates linked to RBI guidelines
MUDRA Card providing an overdraft facility for working capital requirements
eligibility: Any Indian citizen having a viable business idea or running an existing micro/small non-farm enterprise
Enterprises engaged in manufacturing, processing, trading, services, or agri-allied activities (dairy, poultry, beekeeping, agro-processing)
Applicant must not be a willful defaulter to any bank or financial institution and must have a clean credit track record
exclusions: Corporate entities, large-scale industrial companies, and non-individual corporate structures
Direct crop cultivation / direct agricultural crop loan activities (handled via KCC)
Applicants with adverse credit records or willful defaults with any Member Lending Institution
Speculative trading or activities prohibited by law
requiredDocuments: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN Card / Passport)
Proof of Residence (Electricity bill / Aadhaar / Ration Card)
Business registration proof, license, or Udyam Registration Certificate (if existing business)
Project report / business plan specifying technical and financial viability
Bank account statement for the past 6 months
Quotation of machinery, equipment, or assets to be purchased
applicationProcess: Prepare a detailed business plan with cost estimation and required loan tier (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, Tarun Plus)
Apply online via the centralized JanSamarth Portal (jansamarth.in) or UdyamiMitra portal
Alternatively, approach any Public Sector Bank, Private Bank, RRB, SFB, NBFC, or MFI branch with required documents
Lending institution assesses project viability, credit bureau report, and sanctions loan
Borrower receives loan disbursement and MUDRA debit card for working capital withdrawals
source: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sourceDocumentTitle: PMMY Operational Guidelines & JanSamarth Credit Framework
unresolvedQuestions: Exact bank-specific interest rate variations across Member Lending Institutions (MLIs)
State-level stamp duty applicability on loan agreements

unsupportedCriteria: Enterprise must be non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprise
Applicant must not be a willful defaulter to any bank or financial institution
Must have a satisfactory credit track record and viable business project proposal
Tarun Plus tier (Rs 10L-20L) strictly requires past successful repayment of Tarun loan

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: Centrally sponsored rural housing scheme aiming to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and those living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
benefits: Financial grant of Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/northeastern states
Additional Rs. 12,000 assistance for toilet construction under Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin (SBM-G)
90 to 95 person-days of unskilled labor support under MGNREGS (approx. Rs. 20,000 - 25,000)
Minimum house size of 25 sq. meters including a dedicated cooking space and toilet
Direct transfer to beneficiary bank account in three or four progress-linked geotagged installments
eligibility: Houseless households or households living in zero, one, or two-room houses with kutcha walls and kutcha roof
Deprived households identified and ranked via the Socio-Economic and Caste Census (SECC) 2011 and validated through the Awaas+ survey and Gram Sabha
Households with no adult member between age 16-59, female-headed households with no adult male member, households with disabled members, or SC/ST/minority rural households
exclusions: Households owning a pucca house anywhere in India
Households owning motorized three-wheeler or four-wheeler vehicles or motorized agricultural equipment
Households holding a Kisan Credit Card (KCC) with credit limit of Rs. 50,000 or above
Households with any family member who is a government employee (central, state, PSU, or local body)
Households with any family member earning more than Rs. 15,000 per month
Households with any family member paying Income Tax or Professional Tax
Households owning 2.5 acres or more of irrigated land or 5 acres or more of unirrigated land
Households owning registered non-agricultural enterprises
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar card of all adult family members
Aadhaar-linked bank account passbook
MGNREGA Job Card number
Consent letter for geotagging and Aadhaar usage
Gram Sabha resolution / Awaas+ registration ID
applicationProcess: Beneficiary names are prioritized from the SECC 2011 / Awaas+ list verified by Gram Sabha
Field verification and geotagging of existing kutcha house done by Gram Panchayat official using AwaasApp
Sanction order generated by Block Development Office / District Rural Development Agency (DRDA)
First installment credited to account for foundation construction; subsequent installments released after geotagged inspection at plinth, window, and roof levels
source: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
sourceDocumentTitle: PMAY-G Framework for Implementation & 10-Parameter Automatic Exclusion Criteria
unresolvedQuestions: Variation in top-up subsidy grants across individual State Governments
Current rollout status of newly revised Awaas+ survey lists for 2024-2029

unsupportedCriteria: Must be listed on SECC 2011 / Awaas+ rural deprivation list with zero or kutcha house
Strict exclusion: Ownership of motorized 3/4-wheeler or mechanized agricultural equipment
Strict exclusion: Kisan Credit Card limit >= Rs 50,000
Strict exclusion: Family member in government employment or earning > Rs 15,000/month
Strict exclusion: Family member paying Income Tax or Professional Tax
Strict exclusion: Landholding of >= 2.5 acres irrigated or >= 5 acres unirrigated land

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme providing health cover of Rs. 5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization across public and empaneled private hospitals.
benefits: Comprehensive health coverage of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis
Cashless and paperless treatment at all empaneled public and private healthcare facilities
Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses including diagnostics and medicines
No restriction on family size, age, or gender; pre-existing medical conditions covered from day one
Covers over 1,949 treatment procedures across medical and surgical specialties
eligibility: Rural households belonging to defined SECC 2011 deprivation categories (D1: single room kutcha house, D2: no adult age 16-59, D3: female headed no adult male, D4: disabled member no able adult, D5: SC/ST, D7: landless manual casual labor)
Urban households belonging to 11 occupational categories of workers (ragpickers, beggars, domestic workers, street vendors, construction workers, transport workers, etc.)
Senior citizens aged 70 years and above (Ayushman Vay Vandana card) regardless of family income as expanded in 2024
exclusions: Rural households with pucca houses or owning motorized vehicles or mechanized agricultural equipment
Households with regular government employees or pensioners
Households paying Income Tax or owning agricultural land above threshold limits
Households not enlisted in SECC 2011 database (unless covered under state-specific expanded schemes)
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card
Ration Card or PM-JAY Family Identification Letter (HHID)
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar for biometric/OTP e-KYC
Ayushman Golden Card (generated after verification)
applicationProcess: Check eligibility on the official portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) using mobile number, Aadhaar number, or Ration Card number
If found eligible in the database, complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, fingerprint, or iris scan
Verify family details and submit application for Ayushman Card approval
Download the Ayushman Bharat Golden Card or collect plastic card from nearest CSC or Empaneled Hospital helpdesk
source: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
sourceDocumentTitle: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY Operational Guidelines & Identification Criteria
unresolvedQuestions: Technical timeout on legacy portal pmjay.gov.in requiring routing to nha.gov.in and beneficiary.nha.gov.in
Exact interstate portability dispute resolution procedures in non-implementing states

unsupportedCriteria: Must be enlisted in SECC 2011 database under defined deprivation criteria or target NFSA lists
Must undergo e-KYC verification and obtain official Ayushman Bharat Card
Strict exclusion of households owning motorized vehicles or pucca houses in rural areas
Strict exclusion of government employees and income tax paying families

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Government of India-backed small savings scheme under Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign, offering high interest and sovereign tax exemption to secure the higher education and marriage expenses of girl children.
benefits: High sovereign-backed interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a., compounded annually)
Triple tax exemption under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act (Exempt-Exempt-Exempt: deposit, interest, and maturity tax-free)
Partial withdrawal up to 50% of the balance permitted for higher education once the girl attains age 18 or passes Class 10
Flexible deposit range from minimum Rs. 250 to maximum Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year for up to 15 years
Account matures upon completion of 21 years from account opening or upon marriage after age 18
eligibility: The account can be opened for any resident Indian girl child from birth up to 10 years of age
Opened and operated by natural parents or legal guardian on behalf of the minor girl child
Only one account is permitted in the name of a girl child; maximum two accounts per family (with exception for twins/triplets)
exclusions: Non-resident Indians (NRIs) and foreign nationals are not eligible
Opening an account for a girl child older than 10 years is prohibited
More than one account for the same girl child is invalid
Deposits in excess of Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year earn no interest and are refunded
requiredDocuments: Birth Certificate of the girl child issued by municipal/competent authority
Identity proof of the parent/legal guardian (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID, Passport)
Address proof of parent/guardian (Aadhaar Card, utility bill, Ration Card)
Recent passport-size photographs of the girl child and parent/guardian
applicationProcess: Obtain Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form from any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch
Fill in girl child's details, parent/guardian details, and initial deposit amount (minimum Rs. 250)
Attach copy of girl child's birth certificate and KYC documents of parent/guardian
Submit form and initial deposit cash/cheque/DD at the counter
Receive SSY passbook with account number, holder details, and transaction entries
source: Department of Posts / Department of Economic Affairs, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sourceDocumentTitle: Government Savings Promotion Act - Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme, 2019 (GSR 914(E))
unresolvedQuestions: Digital application varies by bank; India Post requires initial physical form submission, while IPPB enables online deposits

Only one account permitted in the name of a girl child across all post offices and authorized commercial banks
Account must be opened and operated by natural parents or legal guardian on behalf of the minor girl child until age 18

name: PM SVANidhi
description: Special micro-credit facility providing affordable collateral-free working capital loans to urban and peri-urban street vendors to resume and expand their livelihoods.
benefits: Initial working capital loan up to Rs. 10,000 with 1-year tenure
Enhanced second tranche loan up to Rs. 20,000 and third tranche loan up to Rs. 50,000 upon timely repayment
Interest subsidy of 7% per annum credited quarterly directly into the vendor's bank account via DBT
Cashback incentive of up to Rs. 1,200 per year (Rs. 100 per month) on conducting digital transactions
No collateral or processing fee required from eligible street vendors
eligibility: Street vendors vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020
Vendors in possession of Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs)
Vendors identified in the ULB vending survey or issued Letter of Recommendation (LoR) by the Town Vending Committee (TVC)
Vendors of surrounding peri-urban/rural areas vending in the geographical limits of the ULBs
exclusions: Non-street vendor businesses, established shops, permanent commercial establishments
Vendors operating exclusively in rural areas with no commercial footprint in urban local body jurisdictions
Vendors who have willfully defaulted on past bank loans without resolution
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card
Voter Identity Card
Certificate of Vending / Vendor Identity Card / Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB/TVC
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar-seeded)
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
applicationProcess: Verify vendor eligibility and status on the official portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in)
Apply online directly or through Common Service Centre (CSC) or Urban Local Body helpdesk
Select preferred Member Lending Institution (Public/Private Bank, SFB, MFI, SHG)
Upload Aadhaar, Vending Certificate/LoR, and bank details
Loan application processed and sanctioned directly into vendor's Aadhaar-linked bank account
source: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
sourceDocumentTitle: PM SVANidhi Scheme Guidelines & Letter of Recommendation (LoR) Protocol
unresolvedQuestions: Differences in Town Vending Committee (TVC) constitution speed across tier-2 and tier-3 municipalities

Must have engaged in street vending in urban/peri-urban jurisdiction on or before March 24, 2020
Second tranche (Rs 20k) and third tranche (Rs 50k) strictly contingent on timely repayment of previous tranche

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: Flagship Karnataka state guarantee scheme providing monthly financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 directly to women heads of families to empower homemakers and alleviate household financial distress.
benefits: Direct cash assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month deposited directly into beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Continuous monthly DBT support throughout the financial year
Free online application with zero processing fees
eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent woman resident of Karnataka
Applicant woman must be designated as the Head of the Family in Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards issued by Food and Civil Supplies Department
Only one woman per household / ration card is eligible to receive benefits
Bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded with active NPCI mapping
exclusions: Households where the woman or her husband is an Income Tax payer
Households where the woman or her husband files Goods and Services Tax (GST) returns
Households where a male member is registered as the family head on the ration card (unless corrected or modified)
Government employees or pensioners' families under specific high-income brackets
requiredDocuments: Ration Card (Antyodaya / BPL / APL) issued by Karnataka Government
Aadhaar Card of the applicant woman
Aadhaar Card of the husband (if married)
Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook with NPCI mapping
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar
applicationProcess: Check scheduled appointment slot via SMS or on Seva Sindhu Guarantee portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in)
Visit designated center: Grama One, Karnataka One, Bengaluru One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra
Present Ration Card and Aadhaar cards of self and husband for biometric/OTP authentication
Operator enters details, prints physical acknowledgment slip, and application is registered
Monthly grant transferred directly through DBT following administrative validation
source: Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka
sourceDocumentTitle: Karnataka Government Order No. WCD 120 MMW 2023 & Seva Sindhu Guarantee Guidelines
unresolvedQuestions: Periodic physical re-verification drives conducted by Anganwadi workers requiring biometric re-authentication

Mandatory NPCI Aadhaar-seeded bank account mapping

name: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Scheme
description: Karnataka state government guarantee scheme providing monthly unemployment assistance of Rs. 3,000 for degree holders and Rs. 1,500 for diploma holders for up to 2 years while seeking employment.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 3,000 for unemployed graduates (general, technical, and professional degrees)
Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1,500 for unemployed diploma holders
Disbursed directly via DBT for a maximum duration of 2 years or until gaining employment/self-employment
Complimentary skill training and job placement assistance provided through Karnataka Skill Development Corporation (KSDC)
eligibility: Must be a domicile of Karnataka who has studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years
Must have completed graduate degree or diploma in the 2022-23 academic year or subsequent academic years from a recognized Karnataka board/university
Must remain continuously unemployed or non-self-employed for at least 180 days (6 months) from date of passing results
Must possess Aadhaar-seeded active bank account
exclusions: Employed individuals in government, public sector, private companies, or contract/temporary roles
Self-employed individuals or those carrying out independent business or commercial practice
Candidates pursuing higher education (post-graduation, second degrees, or full-time diploma/degrees)
Beneficiaries already availing apprenticeship allowances or other government unemployment stipends
requiredDocuments: SSLC/10th marks card and 12th/PUC marks card
Degree certificate / Diploma certificate / Provisional passing certificate
DigiLocker / National Academic Depository (NAD) verified education credentials
Karnataka Domicile proof (study certificate for 6 years in Karnataka)
Aadhaar Card and Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook
applicationProcess: Log in to the Seva Sindhu Guarantee portal (sevasindhugs.karnataka.gov.in) with Aadhaar and mobile OTP
Select 'Yuva Nidhi Application' and enter university registration/roll number to fetch degree data via NAD/DigiLocker
Self-declare unemployment status (minimum 180 days post graduation)
Submit application; verified automatically against PF/ESIC databases and educational repositories
Monthly DBT disbursed following monthly self-declaration of continuing unemployment
source: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood, Government of Karnataka
sourceDocumentTitle: Karnataka Government Order No. SDEL 137 EAP 2023 & Seva Sindhu Yuva Nidhi Guidelines

Must have studied in Karnataka for at least 6 years (domicile verification)

Strict exclusion: Enrolled in higher education, employed in private/govt sector, or receiving other stipend

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
description: Flagship Maharashtra state welfare scheme providing monthly financial assistance of Rs. 1,500 to underprivileged adult women aged 21-65 years to foster economic independence and self-reliance.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 1,500 per month deposited directly into beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account
Yearly total assistance of Rs. 18,000 per eligible woman
Direct assistance to meet nutritional, educational, and household emergency needs
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident / domicile of Maharashtra state
Married, widowed, divorced, abandoned, destitute women, and one unmarried woman per family aged 21 to 65 years
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 (Rs. 2.5 Lakh)
Must have an active bank account in own name seeded with Aadhaar
exclusions: Families where any member pays Income Tax
Families where any member is a permanent/regular government employee, board director, or pensioner
Families owning a four-wheeler vehicle (tractors are exempted)
Families holding more than 5 acres of agricultural land
Beneficiaries already receiving Rs. 1,500 or more per month from any other government DBT scheme
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar Card of the applicant
Maharashtra Domicile Certificate or 15-year Ration Card / Voter ID / School Leaving Certificate
Tehsildar-issued Income Certificate (not exceeding Rs. 2.50 Lakh) or Yellow/Orange Ration Card
Bank passbook copy with Aadhaar-linked account details
Self-declaration affidavit confirming compliance with scheme exclusions
applicationProcess: Download the official Nari Shakti Doot mobile application or visit ladkibahin.maharashtra.gov.in
Register with mobile number and Aadhaar OTP authentication
Fill in demographic, address, family, and bank account information
Upload photograph, Aadhaar card, ration card/income certificate, and submit
Application vetted by Ward Committee in urban areas or Anganwadi/Panchayat committee in rural areas, followed by DBT credit
source: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Maharashtra

Strict exclusion: Any family member paying Income Tax or regular government employee/pensioner
Strict exclusion: Family owning four-wheeler vehicle (tractors exempted)
Strict exclusion: Beneficiary receiving >= Rs 1,500/month from other government DBT schemes

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
description: Uttar Pradesh state government conditional cash transfer scheme providing phased financial assistance up to Rs. 25,000 across 6 educational and health milestone stages of a girl child from birth to higher education.
benefits: Total financial grant of Rs. 25,000 per girl child disbursed directly through DBT across 6 milestone stages
Stage 1: Rs. 5,000 at birth (born on/after 01/04/2019)
Stage 2: Rs. 2,000 upon complete 1-year immunization
Stage 3: Rs. 3,000 upon admission in Class 1
Stage 4: Rs. 3,000 upon admission in Class 6
Stage 5: Rs. 5,000 upon admission in Class 9
Stage 6: Rs. 7,000 upon passing Class 10/12 and taking admission in bachelor degree/2-year diploma
Direct DBT transfer into mother/father/guardian bank account (or girl's account for Stage 6)
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident and domicile of Uttar Pradesh
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 (Rs. 3 Lakh)
Maximum two girl children per family eligible (extended to three if twin girls are born in the second delivery)
Legally adopted girl children are eligible within the two-girl family limit
exclusions: Families whose annual income exceeds Rs. 3,00,000
Families residing outside Uttar Pradesh
Third girl child in a family (unless born as part of a twin delivery on the second birth)
Girls not enrolled in formal schooling or recognized degree/diploma institutions
requiredDocuments: UP Domicile Certificate / Residence Proof (Ration Card, Voter ID, Aadhaar)
Aadhaar Card of the girl child and parents/guardians
Competent authority Income Certificate (income <= Rs. 3 Lakh)
Stage-specific proof: Birth Certificate (Stage 1), Immunization Card (Stage 2), School/College Admission Certificate and Fee Receipt (Stages 3-6)
Joint bank passbook copy of parent/girl child
Notarized family affidavit confirming number of living children
applicationProcess: Visit the official MKSY portal (mksy.up.gov.in) and register as a citizen
Verify mobile number and Aadhaar OTP to create login credentials
Select appropriate stage (1 to 6) matching girl child's current milestone
Fill in parent and child details, upload domicile, income, and stage certificates
Application verified by Block Development Officer (rural) or SDM (urban) within 15 days, followed by DBT credit
source: Department of Women Welfare, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sourceDocumentTitle: Uttar Pradesh MKSY Guidelines & Stage-Wise Operational Procedures
